_roles_doc: docs/team_roles.md (division of work, review matrix, shared workstreams, feedback loops); names A–D are placeholders
collaboration: **Owner plus reviewer.** Every section has one lead and a different member as reviewer, who checked its code, numbers and wording before each freeze (reviewers: §0 D, §1–§2 B, §3 A, §4 D, §5 A, §6 D, §7 C, §8 D, §9 C, §10 all).

**Shared workstreams.** Problem framing and pre-registration (all, chaired by A), label definition (C, D, A), the leak hunt (B, D, C), bias mitigation (C finds, B implements, D evaluates), the claims ledger (all, D owns) and the video (all, A coordinates).

**Feedback loops.** Downstream findings changed upstream work before each freeze: B's XPT finding → A's loader fix; C's redundancy and skewness → B's steps P04, P05, P13; C's treatment masking → the union label and D's E-SCREEN population; D's leakage pilot → the availability rule; B's sensitivity results → D's claim downgrades.
**Two-person gates.** Each freeze was approved by two members before the tag was set (scope: A+B; target: C+A; pre-registration: D+A; experiments: D+B; content: all four).
